DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。住所のお手続きで、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your address procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 網走市内で引っ越しました。携帯で転出の申請を開いたのですが、このまま送れば住所が変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市内で転居したので、開いている転出申請を送信して住所変更してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved within Abashiri. I've opened a moving-out application on my phone. If I submit it as it is, will my address be changed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you moved within the city and ask whether to submit the open moving-out application to change your address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引っ越し前と後は、どちらも網走市内ですか。転出の申請はまだ送信されていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are both your old and new addresses within Abashiri? Have you not submitted the moving-out application yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方とも市内です。まだ送っていません。市外へ出るわけではないので、違う申請を選んだようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新旧住所はどちらも市内で、まだ送信しておらず市外転出とは違う申請を選んだようだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both are within the city. I haven't sent it yet. Since I'm not moving out of the city, it seems I've selected the wrong application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both addresses are within the city, you have not submitted it, and you seem to have selected the wrong application for an out-of-city move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 市内の住所変更として担当窓口へご案内します。引っ越したのは、ご家族全員でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll direct you to the counter for a change of address within the city. Has your whole family moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私だけです。親は元の住所に残っています。世帯全員に印を付けそうでしたが、私の分だけ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居したのは自分だけで親は旧住所に残り、世帯全員の変更にはしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just me. My parents are staying at the old address. I nearly checked the whole-household box, but I'd like to discuss only my own change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say only you moved and your parents remain at the old address, so this is not a change for the whole household. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人だけの異動として、必要な記入を確認してください。新しい住所と住み始めた日がわかる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the required entries for a move by you alone. Do you have documents showing the new address and when you started living there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書に部屋番号はあります。契約の開始日と実際に住み始めた日が違うので、どちらを伝えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約書の部屋番号を示し、契約開始日と実際の入居日が違うため必要な日付を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contract has the room number. Its starting date differs from the date I actually started living there, so I'd like to check which date to give.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the room number on the contract and say you want to check the required date because the contract start and actual move-in dates differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 契約日と実際の転居日を分けて担当に伝えてください。届け出に必要な日付は、担当の案内で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge the contract date and actual moving date separately. Let's follow their guidance to check the date needed for the notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 市内転居で私だけの変更です。旧住所、新住所、契約開始日、実際の転居日を分けて用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分だけの市内転居として、新旧住所、契約開始日、実際の転居日を分けて用意すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's a move within the city for me alone. I'll prepare the old address, new address, contract start date, and actual moving date separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare the old and new addresses, contract start date, and actual moving date separately for your own move within the city. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。送信前に気づかれてよかったです。担当窓口で必要な手続きを確認してください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'm glad you noticed before submitting it. Please check the necessary procedure at the appropriate counter. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。検査の受付で、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there something you need help with at test reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約した検査の受付に来ました。似た名前の案内を見て並んだのですが、この場所で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た検査名の案内を見て並んだので、予約した検査の受付がここで正しいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come to register for a test I booked. I joined this line after seeing instructions with a similar test name. Is this the right place?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you joined the line after seeing a similar test name and ask whether this is the correct reception for your booked test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票で検査名と受付の指定を確認しましょう。今日はどの書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the test name and designated reception on your appointment slip. Which documents have you brought today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この予約票です。略して覚えていた名前と、ここに書かれた正式な名前が違います。別の受付に並んだかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約票の正式名が覚えていた略称と違い、別の受付に並んだ可能性があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This appointment slip. The official name written here differs from the shortened name I remembered. I may have joined a different reception line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the appointment slip's official name differs from the abbreviation you remembered and you may be in the wrong reception line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約票には「腹部超音波検査」、受付は「検査受付B」と書かれています。ここは受付Aなので、この票の受付とは違います。準備の説明書もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The slip says 'abdominal ultrasound examination' and 'test reception B.' This is reception A, so it differs from the reception on your slip. Do you also have the preparation instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありますが、朝の飲み物について読み違えたかもしれません。指示と違うことをした可能性も、受付で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝の飲み物について準備指示を読み違えた可能性があり、実際にしたことを受付で知らせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but I may have misread the part about morning drinks. I'd like to tell reception that I might have done something different from the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you may have misread the preparation instructions about morning drinks and want to report what you actually did at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備のことは、検査担当へ必ずお知らせください。ここで検査できるかを判断せず、担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please be sure to tell the testing staff about the preparation. We won't decide here whether the test can go ahead; we'll check with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 何時に何を飲んだかはメモしました。黙って検査を受けず、このメモを見せて今後の指示を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲んだ物と時刻のメモを示し、黙って検査を受けず担当者の指示を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've noted what I drank and when. Rather than have the test without saying anything, I'll show this note and ask for instructions on what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your note of what you drank and when, and say you will ask the staff for instructions rather than undergo the test without telling them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に連絡しました。まず受付Bで予約票と飲んだ物・時刻のメモを見せるよう案内されています。検査を行えるかは、その担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've contacted the testing staff. They've asked you to first show your appointment slip and the note of what you drank and when at reception B. They will check whether the test can go ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付AではなくBですね。腹部超音波検査の予約票と、飲んだ物と時刻のメモを見せます。検査できるかは担当の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付Bという案内を復唱し、腹部超音波検査の予約票と飲んだ物・時刻のメモを示して担当の判断を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Reception B, not A, then. I'll show the abdominal ultrasound appointment slip and my note of what I drank and when. I'll wait for the staff to check whether the test can go ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the directions to reception B and say you will show the abdominal ultrasound slip and drink-and-time note, then wait for the staff's decision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、受付Bです。検査前の準備に関するご申告も伝えました。こちらの案内表示をご一緒に確認します。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, reception B. I've also passed on your report about preparation before the test. Let's check these direction signs together. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何がありましたか。すぐに伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What has happened? I'll listen right away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一緒にいた母と離れてしまい、連絡が取れません。土地に不慣れなので、今すぐ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一緒にいた母とはぐれて連絡が取れず、土地に不慣れなためすぐに相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've become separated from my mother, who was with me, and can't contact her. She doesn't know the area, so I'd like help right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are separated from your mother and cannot contact her, and want immediate help because she is unfamiliar with the area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に一緒にいた場所と時刻、お母様の服装を教えてください。移動や会話に困ることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where and when you were last together and what your mother is wearing. Does she have any difficulty moving around or communicating?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この売場で十分ほど前です。青い上着を着ています。歩けますが、携帯の操作は苦手で、この辺りの道も知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十分ほど前の売場と青い上着を示し、母は歩けるが携帯操作と周辺の道には不慣れだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In this section, about ten minutes ago. She's wearing a blue jacket. She can walk, but isn't good at using her phone and doesn't know the roads around here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the section where you were together about ten minutes ago and her blue jacket, and explain that she can walk but is unfamiliar with phone use and the local roads. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状況を確認しながら対応します。お母様の電話に連絡しましたか。位置の情報があっても、その意味を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll respond while checking the situation. Have you tried calling your mother's phone? Even if there is location information, let's check what it means.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話は何度かしました。位置は駐車場に出ていますが、車に携帯を置いた可能性があるので、母がそこにいるとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話は試したが位置表示は携帯の場所であり、母が車に携帯を置いた可能性もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've called several times. The location shows the car park, but she may have left her phone in the car, so I can't say she's there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have tried calling but the location display is for the phone, which your mother may have left in the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 携帯の位置とご本人の位置を分けて記録します。ご自身が探しに移動する前に、連絡先と待機の場所を担当と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record the phone's location separately from her location. Before moving to search yourself, please confirm your contact details and where to wait with the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今、母から別の人の電話で連絡がありました。「東案内所」にいると言っています。まだ会えていないので、この新しい情報をすぐ担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母から別の電話で東案内所にいると連絡が来たが合流はまだなので、新情報をすぐ担当へ伝えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My mother has just called from someone else's phone. She says she's at the East Information Center. We haven't met up yet, so please pass this new information to the staff in charge immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your mother called from another phone saying she is at the East Information Center, but you have not met up, and ask for the new information to be passed on immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今すぐ担当へ伝えました。「お母様から連絡あり、東案内所にいるとの話、合流は未確認」と記録を更新しました。案内所の場所と合流方法は担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've told them immediately. I've updated the record to 'Mother has called; says she is at the East Information Center; meeting up is unconfirmed.' Let's check the center's location and how to meet up with the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母から東案内所にいると連絡があっただけで、合流はまだですね。その記録で合っています。担当と場所を確認して向かい、会えたら結果も知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母との連絡は取れたが合流は未確認という記録を確認し、担当と場所を確かめて会えたら結果も知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: So my mother has only told me she's at the East Information Center; we haven't met up yet. That record is correct. I'll check the location with the staff and head there, then report once we've met.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the record that contact has been made but meeting up is unconfirmed, and say you will check the location with staff and report the outcome once you meet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、連絡が取れたことと、実際に会えたことを分けて確認します。担当の案内を続けますので、合流状況をお知らせください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We'll check having made contact separately from having actually met. We'll continue guiding you, so please tell us whether you've met up. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。配達のことで、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your delivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在票の番号を入力しても再配達を申し込めません。携帯の写真を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票の番号で再配達を申し込めないので、写真と入力画面を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't request redelivery even when I enter the number on the missed-delivery notice. Could you look at the photo on my phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the notice number does not let you request redelivery and ask to have the photo and entry screen checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の配達日と、入力している番号の欄を確認しましょう。今回入っていた不在票はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the delivery date in the photo and the number field you're entering. Have you brought the notice left this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙は持っています。写真は先月の不在票で、別の荷物でした。今回のものを見ずに入力していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回の不在票は持参しているが、写真は先月の別荷物で古い番号を入力していたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the paper. The photo is last month's notice for a different parcel. I was entering it without looking at the current notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself that you have the current notice but the photo is for a different parcel last month and you were entering the old number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、今回の不在票に書かれた案内を使いましょう。番号が複数ある場合は、入力欄の名称を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's use the instructions on this time's notice. If there are multiple numbers, check the name of the field you need to enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回の票には番号の欄が二つあります。画面が求める番号の名前をよく見ずに入力していました。どの欄を使うか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今回の票に複数の番号欄があるため、画面が求める名称と同じ欄を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This notice has two number fields. I was entering a number without looking closely at the name the screen asked for. I'd like to check which field to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say this notice has multiple number fields and you want to check the field matching the name requested on the screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この不在票の案内と画面を照らし合わせてご説明します。入力前に宛名と配達日もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain by comparing this notice's instructions with the screen. Please also check the addressee and delivery date before entering anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛名は私で、配達日は昨日です。明日の夜を希望しますが、画面に出ている候補から選べばいいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の宛名は自分、配達日は昨日で、明日の夜を希望し画面の受付可能な候補を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm the addressee, and the delivery date was yesterday. I'd like tomorrow evening, but I should choose from the options shown on the screen, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that this notice is addressed to you and dated yesterday, and check the screen's available options while requesting tomorrow evening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、申し込める日時の表示に従ってください。選択しただけでは完了しない場合もあるので、最後の確認まで進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, follow the dates and times shown as available for requests. Selecting one alone may not finish the process, so continue through the final confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い写真を使わず、今回の案内の番号で申し込みます。宛名と日時を確かめ、申込完了の表示も保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い写真ではなく今回の票で番号と宛名、日時を確認し、申込完了表示を保存すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't use the old photo. I'll request redelivery with the number in the current instructions. I'll check the addressee and date and time, and save the request-complete screen too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the current notice rather than the old photo, check the number, addressee, and date and time, and save the completion screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。操作で迷ったら確定前にお尋ねください。再配達のお手続きありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If you're unsure about an operation, please ask before confirming it. Thank you for arranging redelivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。振り込みの操作で、何をご確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about making a transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの相手に振り込みたいです。名前は合っていますが、保存した振込先と新しい請求書の支店が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: いつもの振込先と新しい請求書の支店情報が違うので、送金前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to pay my usual recipient. The name matches, but the branch on the new invoice differs from my saved transfer details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the branch on your saved transfer details differs from the new invoice and you want to check before sending money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ確定していませんね。保存先の情報と、今回の請求書の金融機関、支店、番号を照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't confirmed it yet, right? Let's compare the saved details with the financial institution, branch, and account number on this invoice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確定していません。金融機関は同じですが支店と番号が変わっています。カナの名前だけ同じなら大丈夫だと思いかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ確定しておらず、金融機関は同じだが支店と番号が違い、名義の一致だけで判断しかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't confirmed it. The financial institution is the same, but the branch and number have changed. I nearly assumed it was okay just because the name in kana matched.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not confirmed it, the institution matches but the branch and number differ, and you nearly relied only on the matching account name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前の一致だけでは確認できません。振込先の変更が本当か、相手の確認済みの連絡先に照会できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The name matching alone isn't enough to verify it. Can you check whether the change is genuine using the recipient's verified contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者へ電話しましたが、今日は返事がありません。期限が近いので急いでいますが、確認できるまで送るのを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既知の担当者へ照会中で返事がなく、期限が近くても確認までは送金を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I called the person in charge, but haven't had a reply today. I'm in a hurry because the deadline is close, but I'll wait to send until I can verify it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are awaiting a response from a known contact and will wait for confirmation before transferring, even with the deadline close. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手からの確認後に情報を確かめてください。手数料も、保存先を使う場合と新しい情報を入力する場合で、画面を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the details after receiving their confirmation. Also check the fee on the screen both when using a saved recipient and when entering new details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保存先を上書きせずに、今日は請求書と違う点をメモします。振込手数料を私が負担するかも、相手に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存先は上書きせず相違点を記録し、振込手数料を誰が負担するかも相手に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't overwrite the saved recipient. Today, I'll note the differences from the invoice. I'd also like to ask the recipient whether I'm responsible for the transfer fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not overwrite saved details, will record the differences, and want to ask the recipient who pays the transfer fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 請求額とは別に、手数料の負担を相手と確認してください。必要な総額は、送金を確定する前に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm responsibility for the fee with the recipient separately from the invoiced amount. Check the total needed before confirming the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 支店、番号、名義、手数料負担を相手へ確認します。返事が来るまで確定せず、期限の相談もします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支店、番号、名義、手数料負担を確認してから確定し、返事がない間は期限についても相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll confirm the branch, number, account name, and fee responsibility with the recipient. I won't confirm the transfer until they reply, and I'll discuss the deadline too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the branch, number, name, and fee responsibility before finalizing, and discuss the deadline while waiting for a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できた情報で手続きを進めてください。保存先の更新も慎重に行ってください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please proceed using verified information. Be careful when updating saved recipient details, too. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品の表示で何かご不明ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is anything unclear about the product label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このチーズは、シールの金額からさらに割引されるんでしょうか。期限も短いので、買う前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: チーズのシール価格からさらに割引されるか、期限の短さも含め購入前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Will this cheese be discounted further from the price on the sticker? Its expiry is close too, so I'd like to check before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before buying whether the cheese is discounted further from the sticker price, also considering its short remaining shelf life. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: シールの表記を一緒に見ましょう。「割引後」の金額なのか、「何円引き」なのかで意味が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's read the sticker together. A price 'after discount' means something different from 'a certain amount off.'

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここには割引後とあります。もう一度引かれると思っていました。支払う金額はこの表示を基準に確かめるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: シールは割引後の価格で、さらに引かれると思ったのは誤解だったと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says 'after discount' here. I thought it would be reduced again. So I should use this displayed price as the basis when checking what I'll pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the sticker shows the discounted price and thinking it would be discounted again was a misunderstanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、会計で実際の金額も確認できます。期限は、どの表示を見ていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, you can also check the actual amount at checkout. Which date label are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 賞味期限の表示です。今日開けて少しずつ食べるつもりですが、この日付までは開封後も同じ条件で保存できると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 賞味期限を見ており、開封後も表示日まで同じ条件で保存できると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The best-before date. I planned to open it today and eat it a little at a time, but thought I could store it under the same conditions after opening until that date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are looking at the best-before date and thought the same storage conditions applied after opening until that date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期限の表示だけで開封後の保存を決めないでください。開封後の注意と保存方法も別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't decide storage after opening from the date label alone. Let's separately check the after-opening precautions and storage instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開けたら早めに食べると書いてありますね。一人では残りそうなので、小さい包装の商品と比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開封後の注意を読み、一人では残りそうなので小さい包装と比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says to eat it soon after opening. I may not finish it on my own, so I'd like to compare it with a smaller pack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the after-opening precaution and say you want to compare smaller packs because you may not finish this alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい包装の候補をご案内します。価格だけでなく、内容量と食べ切れる量も比べてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you smaller-pack options. Please compare the quantity and how much you can finish as well as the price when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 割引後の値段と未開封の期限、開封後の注意を分けます。安いから多く買わず、食べ切れる小さいものを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 割引後価格、未開封の期限、開封後の注意を分け、食べ切れる小さい量を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish the discounted price, the unopened best-before date, and the after-opening precautions. I won't buy more just because it's cheap; I'll choose a small amount I can finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish the discounted price, unopened date, and after-opening precautions, and choose a small amount you can finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示を確認して、食べ切れる量をお選びください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the labels and choose an amount you can finish. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園内で、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there something you need help with in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帽子がなくなりました。遊歩道で落としたと思います。届いている物を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊歩道で落としたと思う帽子が届けられていないか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lost my hat. I think I dropped it on the walking path. Can I check whether it's been handed in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to check whether a hat you think you dropped on the walking path has been handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認先をご案内します。帽子の特徴と、最後にかぶっていた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll direct you to where to check. Please describe the hat and where you last wore it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 薄い茶色で、横に小さい星の印があります。最後の写真を見ると、遊歩道に入る前の休憩所ではかぶっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薄茶色で星の印があり、最後の写真では遊歩道前の休憩所でかぶっていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's light brown with a small star on the side. In the last photo, I'm wearing it at the rest area before entering the walking path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the light-brown hat with a star and explain that your last photo shows you wearing it at the rest area before the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その後、帽子を脱いだ記憶はありますか。遊歩道で落としたと確かなわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you remember taking it off afterward? So it's not certain that you dropped it on the walking path, is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩所の中で暑くて脱ぎました。ベンチに置いたかもしれません。遊歩道だけを探すつもりでしたが、休憩所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩所で脱いでベンチに置いた可能性があるため、遊歩道だけでなく休憩所も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I took it off inside the rest area because I was hot. I may have put it on a bench. I intended to search only the path, but I'd like to check the rest area too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you may have left the hat on a bench after taking it off at the rest area, so you want to check there as well as the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休憩所の管理先と、拾得物の確認先をご案内します。ベンチの場所を、地図や写真で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell you the rest area's management contact and where to check lost property. Can you show the bench on a map or photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この写真の奥のベンチです。ただ、今そこに別の人がいるので、自分で人の荷物を触らず、管理の人に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真でベンチを示し、今いる他の利用者の荷物には触らず管理者に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's the bench in the back of this photo. But someone else is there now, so I want to ask the manager rather than touch other people's belongings myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the bench in the photo and say you want to ask the manager without touching the belongings of other visitors there now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。他の方の物を触らず、特徴と場所を担当へ伝えてください。まだ届け出がない場合の連絡方法も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Don't touch other people's belongings; tell the person in charge the features and location. Let's also check how to receive contact if it hasn't been handed in yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 星印の茶色い帽子と、このベンチの場所を伝えます。休憩所と拾得物の確認先を聞き、見つかったらどう連絡を受けるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帽子の特徴とベンチの場所を知らせ、休憩所と拾得物の確認先、発見時の連絡方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll describe the brown hat with a star and this bench's location. I'll ask whom to contact for the rest area and lost property, and check how I'll be contacted if it's found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the hat's features and bench location, and ask for the rest-area and lost-property contacts and how you will be contacted if it is found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。地図と特徴のメモを持って確認先へお尋ねください。帽子が見つかるとよいですね。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the map and your note of its features to the appropriate contact. I hope your hat is found. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動のことで、何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 留萌から帰る交通が遅れているか知りたいです。この駅名の検索結果を見ると列車の時刻があるのですが、今日の案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰りの交通が遅れているか知りたいので、駅名で検索して見つけた列車時刻が今日の案内か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know whether transport home from Rumoi is delayed. This search result for the station name shows train times. Is it information for today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to know whether your transport home is delayed, and ask whether train times found by searching the station name are today's information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い鉄道の案内と、今ご利用になる交通を分けましょう。旧留萌駅から列車が出る前提の案内は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish old railway information from the transport you're using now. Please don't use information based on trains departing from the former Rumoi Station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い記事を開いていました。今日乗るつもりなのはバスです。駅名ではなく、利用する会社と停留所で調べ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 古い記事を開いていたと伝え、今日利用するのはバスなので会社名と停留所で調べ直すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had opened an old article. I'm planning to take a bus today. I'll search again using the operator and bus stop instead of the station name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you opened an old article and will search again by company and stop because today's transport is a bus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。運行情報の更新日時と、対象の便を確認してください。遅延の時刻が出ていなくても、定時運行と決めつけないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Check the update date and time of the service information and the service it applies to. Even if no delay time is listed, don't assume it's running on time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に迎えを頼んでいて、到着時刻を知りたいです。遅れが未定なら、そのまま未定と伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族に迎えを頼んでいるので到着時刻を知りたいが、遅れが未定なら未定のまま家族に伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've asked my family to pick me up, so I'd like to know the arrival time. If the delay is undetermined, I'd like to tell them exactly that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your family is picking you up and you want the arrival time, but will tell them it is undetermined if the delay is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確かな案内がない時は、予定と現在の状況を分けて連絡できます。事業者の確認先も調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When there isn't confirmed information, you can tell them the schedule separately from the current situation. Let's also look up the operator's inquiry contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予定の到着と、今わかっている状況を別々に送ります。乗る便が確認できたら、もう一度連絡するので、案内の更新場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定の到着時刻と現在わかっている状況を別々に家族へ送り、乗る便を確認したら再び連絡するので情報の更新先を教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll send the scheduled arrival and what is currently known separately. I'll contact them again once I confirm the service I'm taking, so please tell me where updates are posted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will separately send your family the scheduled arrival and currently known situation, contact them again after confirming your service, and ask where updates appear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 事業者の公式案内で対象の便と更新時刻を確認しましょう。到着の見込みが案内されていなければ、問い合わせ先へ確認してください。停留所へ向かう前にも最新情報を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the relevant service and update time in the operator's official information. If an expected arrival isn't provided, please check with the inquiry contact. Look at the latest information again before heading to the stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い駅の列車時刻を使わず、会社、停留所、日付で確認します。家族には今は未定と伝え、確認後に更新します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い列車時刻を使わず会社、停留所、日付で確認し、家族には到着が未定と伝えて確認後に連絡を更新すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't use old train times. I'll check the operator, stop, and date. I'll tell my family the arrival is currently undetermined and update them after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the operator, stop, and date rather than old train times, tell your family arrival is undetermined, and update them after verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内を確かめてから移動してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the information before traveling. Thank you for your inquiry. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談の予約について、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with booking a consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生活の手続きで相談したいですが、電話だとうまく説明できません。用件を紙に書いて予約してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 生活の手続きを相談したいが電話では説明しにくいので、用件を紙に書いて予約できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like advice about daily-life procedures, but I find explaining over the phone difficult. Can I write down my questions on paper and make an appointment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want advice about daily-life procedures but find phone explanations difficult, and ask whether you can book by writing down your purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談内容を整理して担当を確認できます。どのようなことが二つあるか、差し支えない範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can organize the topics and check who handles them. Please tell me, as far as you're comfortable, what the two issues are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 届いた通知の読み方と、支払いについての相談です。同じ予約で両方話せると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届いた通知の読み方と支払いの二つを相談したく、同じ予約で両方話せると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understanding a notice I received, and discussing payment. I thought I could talk about both at the same appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want help reading a notice and discussing payment, and thought both could be covered in one appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が異なる可能性があるので、それぞれの内容を確認して予約方法をご案内します。通知はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Different staff may handle them, so we'll check each topic and explain how to book. Do you have the notice with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。個人の番号をこの場所で全部読み上げるより、窓口で紙を見せたいです。通知の件名だけなら伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知は持っているが個人の番号を人前で読み上げず窓口で紙を見せたいと伝え、件名なら話せると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than read all my personal numbers aloud here, I'd like to show the paper at the counter. I can tell you just the notice's title.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the notice but want to show it at the counter instead of reading personal numbers aloud in public, and can give the title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここでは件名と相談の概要から担当を確認しましょう。個人情報の確認は、案内した方法で行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, let's check the appropriate staff using the title and a summary of your questions. Personal information will be checked using the method we explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 件名は「市税の納付についてのご案内」です。支払い相談では分割できるかを聞きたいので、通知を読むだけの相談とは分けてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知の件名を示し、支払いを分割できるか聞きたいので、通知を読む相談とは分けてメモすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The title is 'Information about paying municipal taxes.' For the payment discussion, I want to ask about installments, so I'll note that separately from the request to read the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the notice title and say you will note the installment-payment question separately from understanding the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の希望として担当へ伝えます。分割の可否をここで約束はできません。予約が必要な窓口と持参物を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that on as your consultation request. I can't promise here whether installments are possible. Please check which counter requires an appointment and what to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知内容の確認と分割の相談を別に書きます。それぞれの予約方法と必要書類を確かめてから、窓口で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知の確認と分割払いの相談を別々に書き、それぞれの予約方法と必要書類を確かめてから窓口で説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write checking the notice and discussing installments separately. I'll confirm how to book each and the required documents before explaining at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separately write the notice-checking and installment questions, check booking methods and required documents for each, then explain at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当の案内に沿って予約をお取りください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please book according to the staff's instructions. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診後のご相談で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your question after your medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もらった説明の紙が水で濡れて、読めない行があります。自己判断で補わず、担当へもう一度聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 医療の説明書がぬれて読めないので、自分で補わず、もう一度説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The explanation sheet I received got wet, and some lines are unreadable. Rather than fill in the gaps myself, I'd like to ask the staff again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your medical instruction sheet got wet and cannot be read, and ask for another explanation rather than supplying the missing information yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用紙をお持ちですか。どの部分が読めなくなっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the sheet? Which parts have become unreadable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この下の行です。前に受け取った似た紙はありますが、今回も同じ指示だとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下の行が読めず、似た古い説明書はあるが今回の指示と同じとは限らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This bottom line. I have a similar sheet from before, but I don't assume the instructions are the same this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the bottom line is unreadable and you have a similar old sheet but its instructions may differ from the current ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の説明を担当へ確認します。用紙の上にある氏名や受診日は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check this visit's explanation with the staff. Can you read the name and visit date at the top of the sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前と今日の日付は読めます。友人の紙を借りるのではなく、自分の今日の説明として確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今回の説明書で読める自分の氏名と日付を示し、記録を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read my name and today's date. I want to check my own instructions from today rather than borrow a friend's sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your readable name and date on this instruction sheet and ask for your record to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の説明として照会します。読める行も含め、わからない所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll inquire about your own instructions. Please tell me everything unclear, including anything in the readable lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次に連絡する目安の所です。見えない数字を想像せず、言葉で聞いてメモを取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次に連絡する目安が読めないので、数字を推測せず、説明を聞いてメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The part about when I should contact you next. Rather than guess the number I can't see, I'd like to hear the explanation and take notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you cannot read the guidance on when to contact them next, and want to hear and note the explanation instead of guessing numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が内容を確認してご説明します。聞いた内容も復唱して確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check the details and explain. Please repeat back what you hear to confirm it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 氏名と受診日を示し、読めない行の再説明をお願いします。メモを復唱して、古い紙の数字で埋めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名と日付を確認して再説明を聞き、復唱して確かめ、古い説明書の数字を使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show my name and visit date and ask for the unreadable line to be explained again. I'll repeat back my note to check it and won't fill it with numbers from the old sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm your name and date, hear the explanation again and repeat it to check, without using numbers from the old sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the staff in charge. Take care.
